answer: Degree-normalized trust resists sybils: a voucher's endorsement is divided by how many identities it vouches for, so a node blessing thousands gives each only a whisper of weight. A sybil sponsor cannot cheaply bless a karst of fakes — spreading its trust across a swarm splits it like light through a prism until each shard is negligible. Honest agents vouch sparingly for peers they know, concentrating real weight; a mass-sponsor dilutes itself to nothing, so one captured endorser cannot franchise an army.
